authorization.scope: Analyze SPEC-0001, SPEC-0002 and SPEC-0003 as specimens only

classification.scope: Public disclosure, regardless of information source or wording

comparisons.assessment: NOM-0001 is public-Git-specific and unconditional; this proposal covers public outputs generally, conditional on disclosure authorization.
Some private drafting context conveys nonpublic facts; privacy of source phrasing is a distinct protected interest.
Information confidentiality is independent of revealing private generation provenance.
Private diary storage is not an authorized public disclosure.

disposition.outcome: Separate broad confidentiality rule proposed, not applied or published.

uncertainties: Authorization semantics need contextual definition; the existing repository-level prohibition may remain stricter even where disclosure is otherwise authorized.
